v2.name: V2 readiness
v2.status: Dashboard makeover and recap globally enabled, useful real-provider five-worker cycles unverified
v2.summary: Captured Oct 26 ECS flags in open inventory #729 show global dashboard makeover and morning recap enabled, but no confirmed delivered recap or repeat provider-backed result for all five workers. Owner payment connection is hindered by live Team Chat.

v3.name: V3 / Full 10/10 vision
v3.summary: Global UI/recap rollout evidenced by ECS flags, but an actual owner-flow regression, missing premium website handoffs, full SaaS and custom-agent delivery, mature autonomy and economics remain.

autonomyProof.note: Representative success/attempt denominator is still unavailable; do not imply the 95–99% V3 mature target has been measured.

founderWorkload.note: Darius minutes are not comprehensively separated from operator effort, customer approvals or specialist review.

dimensions.name: Complete customer journey & ownership
dimensions.blocker: Connect how I get paid and other owner dialogs obstructed live by team chat; #728 repair only local-tested; paid-to-site handoff not repeatedly shown.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Verify fixed live payment setup and repeated approval-to-publish/export customer journeys.

dimensions.name: Commercial delivery & acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: Merged public branding/header polish but no verified paid conversion/retention or latest public deployment receipt.

dimensions.blocker: Paid delivery margins, failed-attempt costs, support burden and Darius hours are still not measured on a representative cohort.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Measure paid job margins and Darius intervention time on a representative cohort.

Verify integrations and recurring end-user workflows beyond enabled switches.
Verify recurring recovery and ownership with low technical rescue.
